faq.question: How does Composio handle my Slack data?
faq.answer: Composio executes API calls on behalf of your connected account. All data is encrypted and subject to a 30-day retention policy. Authentication tokens are encrypted at rest and scoped to the permissions you grant during the OAuth flow. For full details on data handling, retention, and third-party data practices, see our [Privacy Policy](https://composio.dev/privacy).

faq.question: How do I set up custom OAuth credentials for Slack?
faq.answer: For a step-by-step guide on creating and configuring your own Slack OAuth credentials with Composio, see [How to create OAuth credentials for Slack](https://composio.dev/auth/slack).

faq.question: When do users see "This app isn't listed in the Slack Marketplace…"?
faq.answer:
When a member of a Slack workspace tries to install a non-Marketplace app.

**How to resolve:** Disable **Require apps from Slack Marketplace** in the workspace's app management settings:

`Settings → Apps & Workflows → App Management Settings`

faq.question: Why am I being asked to submit a request during auth?
faq.answer: Because **Require approved apps** is enabled in the workspace's **App Management Settings**. Slack is asking for admin/owner approval before completing the install.

faq.question: How can a workspace member complete the connection without asking for permissions or approvals?
faq.answer:
Two ways:

- Disable both **Require apps from Slack Marketplace** and **Require approved apps** in the workspace's app management settings.
- Use the workspace's own OAuth app, which is recommended and safest. See [How to create OAuth credentials for Slack](https://composio.dev/auth/slack).

faq.question: Where can I find Slack's available scopes?
Why am I getting a redirect URI mismatch error?
faq.answer: Update the redirect URL in your Slack App under OAuth & Permissions → Redirect URLs.

faq.question: How do I set up Slack event webhooks?
faq.answer: With Composio-managed Slack credentials, the webhook endpoint is already provisioned, so just create the trigger. If you bring your own Slack OAuth app, see [Custom OAuth webhooks](https://docs.composio.dev/docs/setting-up-triggers/custom-oauth-webhooks).
